title: Origin story: Osiris
description: Osiris was the first king of Egypt, who taught mankind agriculture and law. His brother Set murdered him from jealousy, sealed him in a chest, and scattered the pieces. Isis restored him, and he became lord of the underworld — the first to die and the judge of all who follow.

title: Ability profile: Osiris
description: Ranked abilities: Judgment — rank 100/100; Resurrection — rank 100/100; Kingship — rank 96/100; Composure — rank 95/100; Agriculture — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Osiris
description: Powers: Lordship over the entire afterlife; The grain that dies and rises each year; The crook and flail of eternal kingship.

title: Stamina feats: Osiris
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Endured murder, dismemberment, and scattering — and returned; Has judged the dead for millennia.

title: Crossover notes: Osiris
description: Osiris crosses naturally with: the afterlife, resurrection, grain, order.

title: Cultural impact: Osiris
description: The promise that death is not the end — civilization's oldest hope.
